notes.title: Octopath Traveler 0 is available for pre-purchase now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014320/

Start from zero and discover the newest entry in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series. Experience a story of restoration and retribution over the divine rings—an epic saga that unfolds across the realm of Orsterra.

Enjoy familiar features such as the series' HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG; the player's ability to roleplay using Path Actions of their choice; and the Break and Boost system that can turn the tide of battle. Additionally, brand-new features such as character creation and town building allow you to create your own character and restore your hometown.

notes.title: Тираж JRPG-серии Octopath Traveler от Square Enix превысил 5 миллионов копий
notes.content: За несколько лет серия Octopath Traveler превратилась в один из самых крупных и успешных проектов Square Enix. Франшиза продолжает привлекать новых игроков, и на днях издатель сообщил о достижении тиража в 5 миллионов копий.

notes.title: Octopath Traveller II, the latest game in the series, is now on sale!
notes.content:
Octopath Traveller II takes HD-2D even further.

Over five million copies of the Octopath Traveller series games sold!
Now 50% off for a limited time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42946401/e30d15c41fffa882f59900e8253855ff7a747534.png[/img]
Offer ends 2/01 6pm GMT

Producer Takahashi has a message for all travellers setting out on their new journey.

"Our key words when creating Octopath Traveller II were “evolution” over the first game and giving it even greater “depth”. We gave all our efforts to cover everything we wanted to do with the original but didn’t quite make it in.
The stories of Octopath Traveller I and II are completely independent of each other, so there is absolutely no problem with starting your journey from II.
It has been made more accessible and easier to play in numerous ways, so I could even say that starting with II might be recommended."

[previewyoutube=Vqft9zsrUm0;full][/previewyoutube]

Why not join the travellers this festive season?

notes.title: Square Enix продолжит создавать ремейки в формате HD-2D, расширяя границы инновационного визуального стиля
notes.content: В недавнем интервью Digital Trends продюсер Square Enix Масааки Хаясака затронул тему переизданий в в формате HD-2D — визуальном стиле, который полюбился фанатам Octopath Traveler. В скором времени состоится релиз Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, и японский издатель не собирается останавливаться на достигнутом.

notes.title: Чем Xbox Game Pass порадует в июне 2024 — Microsoft раскрыла первую волну игр для подписчиков на консолях Xbox и ПК
notes.content: Компания Microsoft объявила, что в течение ближайших двух недель каталог онлайн-сервиса Game Pass пополнят шесть игр. Среди значимых проектов стоит отметить хоррор The Callisto Protocol от создателя серии Dead Space Глена Скофилда.

notes.title: Octopath Traveler II вышла на консолях Xbox — сразу доступна в Game Pass
notes.content: Octopath Traveler II внезапно вышла на Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One и ПК в Microsoft Store. Стоимость составляет 60 долларов за одну игру или 75 долларов за комплект, в который также входит первая часть.

notes.title: Bundle featuring OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34898046/e40d530821666a16f33a7b3ceac1e16cbab33e6d.png[/img]
OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II: two great HD-2D games from Square Enix's Team Asano in one bundle!

Retro pixel graphics and modern 3DCG come together to create an enchanting HD-2D world where you can embark on an adventure all your own!

[h3][b]■Bundle Contents[/b][/h3]
• OCTOPATH TRAVELER (main game)
• OCTOPATH TRAVELER II (main game)

[h3][b]■OCTOPATH TRAVELER[/b][/h3]
In the faraway land of Orsterra, eight travelers venture forth.
Step into their shoes and explore the realm as you see fit.
Eight brave souls, each with a unique talent.
Eight lands, eight stories to be told.
So tell me, friend, what path will you tread?
Set forth on a journey all your own.

[h3][b]■OCTOPATH TRAVELER II[/b][/h3]
The story takes place in Solistia, a land comprising an
eastern and western continent divided by the sea. 
It is a bustling era, wherein large vessels navigate busy sea routes
and the power of steam gives birth to new technologies.
Some people thrill to glamorous stars of the stage and industry,
while others are brought to tears by war, plague, and poverty.
In this faraway realm, eight travelers hailing from
different regions venture forth for their own reasons.
Step into their shoes and explore the land as you see fit.
Embark on an adventure all your own.

notes.title: You can try out all of Octopath Traveler 2's protagonists in its demo right now
notes.content: We're so close to Octopath Traveler 2's February 24 release date that you can almost taste the anime and, to tide you over until then, Square Enix has put out an Octopath Traveler 2 "Prologue demo" on Steam. Released yesterday, the demo gives you a chance to "explore mechanics like Path Actions" as well as mess around with the combat system, which is "based around storing up actions and exploiting enemy weaknesses"... Read more.

notes.title: The OCTOPATH TRAVELER II Prologue Demo is OUT NOW on STEAM!
notes.content:
The OCTOPATH TRAVELER II Prologue Demo with save data transfer to the full version of the game is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42946401/7b1c72b96e82f1022d2257eb96dae4b8e1521fc4.jpg[/img]

While the story can only be progressed up to the early stages of the game, you can choose to play all eight protagonists just like in the full version, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42946401/a91a8425aa7e689321b0027fe936732a857e390e.jpg[/img]

as well as decide where to go and what to do within the 3 hours and preliminary areas of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42946401/080bc46e2b32b2d6af8bd6a63eb093c392ad7534.jpg[/img]

Choose to make new friends, challenge powerful enemies in dungeons, or simply admire the scenery.
Embark on an adventure all your own.

Click on the 'Download demo' button on the Steam page to start the adventure: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971650

<Game features> 
[list]
[*]Begin your adventure as one of eight new travelers, each with their own origins, motivations, and unique skills.
[*]The series’ HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG, have reached even greater heights.
[*]The story takes place in Solistia, where diverse cultures thrive from east to west and the industries of the new era flourish. You can sail the seas and explore every corner of a world that changes from day to night.
[*]Each traveler has a unique set of Path Actions they can use to battle townspeople, obtain items, take others along in their travels, and more. Where will you go? What will you do? Every path is yours to take.
[*]Familiar mechanics from the original game have been preserved, like the freedom to develop your travelers’ jobs and skills, as well as the Break and Boost system that made battles so exhilarating. New mechanics have also been added.
[/list]

Pre-purchase the game to receive the exclusive 'Travel Provisions' bonus content. This pack contains consumable items that will help you along your journey.

notes.title: Square Enix выпустила новый 5-минутный трейлер Octopath Traveler II — JRPG выходит 24 февраля
notes.content: Square Enix представила ролик Octopath Traveler II, в котором познакомила поклонников с Троном и Теменосом — двумя из восьми новых героев игры. Свежий трейлер также демонстрирует обновлённую систему профессий, которая открывает пользователям больше свободы, чем в оригинале.

notes.title: Here's 20 lovely minutes of beautiful Octopath Traveller 2
notes.content: I'm not sure I'll ever get jaded about the glowing 2.5D graphical style of Octopath Traveler, and there's no better argument for that than the 20 minutes of Octopath Traveler 2 gameplay that Square Enix showed off at Tokyo Game Show during yesterday's livestream. The JRPG sequel is primed to release on February 24th, 2023 via Steam for PC, as well as on PlayStations 4 and 5, and the Switch... Read more.

notes.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II - Pre-order Now!
notes.content:
This game is a brand-new entry in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series, the first installment of which was initially released in 2018 and sold over 3 million copies worldwide. It takes the series’ HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG, to even greater heights.
In the world of Solistia, eight new travelers venture forth into an exciting new era.
Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take. 
Embark on an adventure all your own.

Receive the Travel Provisions DLC pack when you pre-order the game.
It contains consumable items to help you along your journey.

■Contents
・Healing Grape (M) x 5
・Inspiriting Plum (M) x 5
・Revitalizing Jam x 2
・Gold Dust (can be sold for 5,000 leaves in game) x 1

*This pack may be available for purchase at a later date.
*These items can also be obtained by progressing through the game.
